decisive_items: Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli
Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
Bilateral upper-zone and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions, worse on the left side
response.rationale: Acid-fast bacilli with necrotizing granulomas in lymph node and skin, plus pulmonary infiltrates, strongly indicate disseminated tuberculosis. R2C is a narrower extrapulmonary label but ignores lung involvement; other candidates lack AFB positivity or are contradicted by serology.

rejected.why: Polyarthritis without small joints and negative RF/anti-CCP; AFB positivity excludes RA.
ANCA negative and AFB positive; nodules are not vasculitic.
Extrapulmonary label underrepresents pulmonary infiltrates; R2 is more accurate.
ANCA negative and AFB positive; GPA unlikely.
AFB positive contradicts sarcoidosis; ACE normal.
Skin-only lupus vulgaris misses lymph node and lung involvement.
Necrotizing granulomas and AFB positive are not lymphoma features.
